title: Spiced Chaas
subtitle: Mint · Roasted cumin · 5 min · 2 adults + toddler

method.title: Blend aromatics
items: Add mint {10–12 leaves}, coriander {small handful} and ginger {½ inch} to a blender

method.title: Mix chaas
items: Add remaining yogurt {¾ cup} and chilled water {2 cups}
Add roasted cumin powder {½ tsp}, black salt {½ tsp} and salt {to taste}
Blend or whisk until light and frothy

method.label: Toddler — pour now, before chili and pepper
items: Pour her glass {½ cup} from the chaas
Optional: stir in a tiny pinch of hing {1 pinch} and serve chilled

method.title: Adult spicing
items: Stir green chili {½, minced} and black pepper {1 pinch} into the remaining chaas
Heat ghee {½ tsp} in a small pan on low
Add hing {1 pinch} and curry leaves {5–6}; sizzle 10 seconds
Pour the tempering over the chaas; add chaat masala {¼ tsp}
Chill 15 minutes or serve over ice

method.label: Tip
method.text: Chaas separates as it sits — whisk again just before pouring.
